questions.title: What is the purpose of 'warp-specialization' in the FlashAttention-3 producer-consumer model?
questions.question_body: I'm reading the section on Producer-Consumer asynchrony and I see that the authors split warps into 'producers' and 'consumers.' I understand that producers handle data movement and consumers handle computation, but I'm confused about why this is better than having every warp do both. Doesn't this just create a bottleneck where the consumers have to wait for the producers to finish?

questions.title: How does the 2-stage pipeline overlap softmax with WGMMA instructions?
questions.question_body: In Algorithm 2, the paper describes a 2-stage GEMM-softmax pipelining scheme. I'm struggling to follow the logic: specifically, how can the softmax for iteration $j+1$ be executed while the second GEMM (the one computing $\mathbf{O}_i$) of iteration $j$ is still running? Since the output of the first GEMM is needed for the softmax, and the softmax output is needed for the second GEMM, I thought these had to be strictly sequential.

questions.title: Why does multiplying by a random orthogonal matrix $\mathbf{M}$ help with FP8 quantization error?
questions.question_body: The paper mentions 'incoherent processing' where $\mathbf{Q}$ and $\mathbf{K}$ are multiplied by a random orthogonal matrix $\mathbf{M}$ before being quantized to FP8. The authors claim this 'spreads out' outliers. I understand the math $(\mathbf{Q} \mathbf{M})(\mathbf{K} \mathbf{M})^{\top} = \mathbf{Q} \mathbf{K}^{\top}$, but I don't understand the intuition: how does rotating the coordinate system of the vectors actually make the quantization to 8-bits more accurate?

questions.title: Confusion regarding FP8 layout constraints: k-major vs mn-major
questions.question_body: In section 2.2, the paper discusses layout requirements for FP8 WGMMA. It says that for FP16, both mn-major and k-major are accepted, but FP8 only supports k-major. I'm confused about what 'k-major' actually means in the context of the $\mathbf{V}$ matrix. Does this mean the data must be contiguous along the head dimension $d$ or the sequence length $N$?

questions.title: How does 'Pingpong Scheduling' differ from the intra-warpgroup overlapping?
questions.question_body: The paper describes two different ways to overlap operations: 'pingpong scheduling' between two warpgroups and 'intra-warpgroup overlapping' using a 2-stage pipeline. Are these two techniques used simultaneously, or are they alternatives? I'm trying to understand if the pingpong scheduling is just a macro-scale version of the 2-stage pipeline.

questions.title: Does block quantization in FP8 FlashAttention-3 introduce any bias into the attention scores?
questions.question_body: The authors propose using block quantization (keeping one scalar per block for $\mathbf{Q}, \mathbf{K}, \mathbf{V}$) to reduce numerical error. Since they are scaling blocks separately, does this change the relative magnitudes of the attention scores $\mathbf{S} = \alpha \mathbf{Q} \mathbf{K}^{\top}$ across different blocks? If so, how is the softmax still computed accurately across the entire sequence length $N$?
